project.goal: A compact vertical 3D shoot-'em-up inspired by classic Raiden-style arcade pacing.

workflow_rules: The user selects or approves a task.
Codex reads AGENTS.md and this graph before editing.
Codex may call the local Ollama reviewer through MCP for planning and review.

The game must remain playable offline and must not call cloud APIs at runtime.
